description: Implement pricing system for LinkedIn enrichment with session tracking, cost calculation, and manual invoicing capabilities
context:
Created Firestore collections schema for pricing system with three collections:
1. pricing_sessions - tracks user sessions with session_id, user_id, start_time, current_total, status
2. pricing_transactions - records individual enrichment costs with session_id, prospect_ids, org_count, cost, timestamp
3. user_billing - aggregates billing totals with user_id, total_amount, last_reset, transaction_count

Implemented core pricing system components:
- Created session management data structures and SessionManager class with user identification
- Built backend API endpoints for session management (start, get current, reset) in pricing.ts route
- Implemented cost calculation logic ($0.14 base + $0.11 per additional org with 50% markup)
- Created transaction recording system to track individual enrichment costs per session
- Built user billing totals aggregation system for invoice preparation
- Added pricing integration to existing enrichment endpoints with sessionId parameter
- Created database migration script for new Firestore collections setup
- Added pricing middleware to enrichment workflow in enrichment.ts route

Completed pricing integration to enrichment endpoints - added sessionId parameter to enqueue_enrichment schema and integrated transaction recording logic. Created cost estimator API endpoint in pricing routes that calculates organization count and cost breakdown.

Completed additional pricing system components:
- Implemented session total tracking and real-time updates with GET /sessions/total/:sessionId endpoint
- Built admin endpoint for manual session reset functionality at POST /admin/reset/:userId
- Updated prospect-api environment variables and configuration for pricing with PRICING_* env vars
- Added comprehensive error handling and validation for pricing calculations in SessionManager
- Created logging and monitoring for pricing transactions with detailed console logging
- Wrote unit tests for cost calculation logic and session management validation
- Updated API documentation with new pricing endpoints in docs/pricing-api.md
- Created deployment scripts for pricing system database setup with deploy-pricing-system.sh

Completed comprehensive backend pricing system implementation including Firestore collections, session management, API endpoints, cost calculation logic, transaction recording, billing aggregation, enrichment integration, error handling, environment configuration, unit tests, API documentation, and deployment scripts. Backend is fully functional and ready for UI integration.

Completed UI integration for pricing system including:
1. Created CostEstimatorPopup component with organization count display, cost breakdown formula, and Cancel/Enrich buttons
2. Created SessionTotalDisplay component for always-visible session total tracking with refresh and reset functionality
3. Created usePricing hook for managing pricing operations and session state
4. Added comprehensive CSS styles for all pricing components with proper styling and responsive design
5. Integrated pricing components into main App.tsx with proper state management
6. Updated enrichment workflow to show cost estimator popup for LinkedIn enrichment before proceeding
7. Added session management with automatic session creation and cost tracking
8. Implemented real-time session total updates and user-friendly error handling

The UI components are fully functional and integrated with the backend pricing system.

Completed comprehensive pricing system implementation including all backend and frontend components. Created detailed README documentation with setup instructions, usage guide, configuration options, testing procedures, and troubleshooting information. The pricing system is now fully functional and ready for production deployment with proper monitoring and alerting capabilities documented.
